issues: The command `flux run ... > job.log` redirects the standard output of all 16 MPI ranks to a single file. This will cause a race condition where multiple processes attempt to write to the file simultaneously, resulting in interleaved and likely unreadable output. I/O should be handled by a single rank or redirected to unique files per rank.

The path to the VASP executable is hardcoded to a specific user's home directory (`/home/joshuapaul/...`). This makes the script non-portable and it will fail if run by any other user or if the directory structure changes.
